svg.title: Formal main and fresh path experiment scope
svg.desc: Main: two datasets by two Students by four seeds by three conditions equals 48 fits. Separate path intervention: one setting, two conditions, two orders and four seeds equals 16 fresh fits. Concentration controls are additional and not included in the 48 count.

g.text: R1 and R2 share REAL; no extra independent seeds
Separate concentration-matched CONTROL comparisons cover all four dataset / Student settings.
Current experiments are single-generation. Recursive experiments remain future work.
